notes: Historic complaints (2006-2019, qgea-i56i) were not ingested. Run with --historic to include them; shootings already span 2006-present.

31 of 1356 schools with 2024 proficiency data could not be placed in a neighborhood: their DBN is absent from the 2019-20 school location file (wg9x-4ke6), which is the newest vintage published. These are mostly charters that opened after 2020.

Food store grades come from 11,766 current inspections (collapsed from 94,910 deficiency rows); 91 could not be placed in a neighborhood. The grade is a sanitation result, not a measure of what a store sells or charges.

Repaired 23,988 incident rows whose latitude and longitude columns were transposed upstream. The Shootings dataset (5ucz-vwe8) ships every record from 2006-01-01 to 2025-12-31 reversed; only 2026 additions are correct. Without this repair 98.7% of shootings would be silently discarded.
